# The largest file a member may send reaches the others whole, though its substream takes more
# boxes than MaxFile/MaxPlaintext: each box carries one byte less than it holds.

create alice g
join bob g
run
invite alice g bob
run
send-file alice g big.bin 16777216
run
show bob g
----
— minting a voucher
— give the voucher code to a member of the group (it is also in voucher-g.txt)
— joined the group
alice: [file big.bin, 16.0 MB]

file bob g big.bin
----
16777216 bytes, as sent
